scope: Editor Watershed debug: connected ocean and shore-bounded potential lake surfaces, draped native spline paths, visibility during native camera LOD. Existing terrain/routing algorithms unchanged.

nativeReuse.terrain: Unchanged native VPP presenter, generation, stamp/material features, LOD and collision
nativeReuse.display: UE GeometryCore Dynamic Mesh/normal overlays/native fan splitting; existing UE translucent material; native FInterpCurveVector linear spline data and screen-space PDI lines
nativeReuse.workOwner: Existing FCLRecipeEvaluation task, cancellation, latest-result fence and shutdown join; no second queue or streaming manager
nativeReuse.audit: Installed VPP height/volume spline stamps are terrain producers. UE Water lake meshes flatten spline polygons to local XY/Z=0 and ocean bodies require a flat surface; these do not directly implement the required spherical read-only debug view. Native USplineComponent.Draw adds editing handles and twenty redundant substeps per already-draped segment. See Docs/WatershedDebugView.md.

behavior.ocean: Only the connected reference ocean classification, at OceanHeight; not every below-sea depression
behavior.lakes: Connected potential lake cells grouped by spill level; shore-clipped translucent constant-radial-level surfaces
behavior.shore: Retained analysis topology plus eight native-height bisection rounds; native saddle-fan splitting preserves positions
behavior.paths: Final selected receiver chains preserve junctions and channel classes, stop at water shores, and use four native-height drape samples per edge; linear native interpolation avoids cubic overshoot
behavior.visibility: Uses native PublishedPlan identity instead of IsUpdating; previous terrain/debug pair retained until replacement publishes
behavior.controls: Existing per-layer indicator icon; reference ocean sphere suppressed while debug is on; no new persisted controls or water assets

validation.finalRerunRationale: After the 17-check regression run passed, image review led to the renderer-only native pixel-width fix and explicit paths-only pixel assertion. All three affected authoring/rendered checks were rerun on final source.
checked: Native manifold mesh validity, independent distinct lake levels and radial water elevations
Shore points agree with final native terrain within 0.5 m in the bounded fixture; measured error recorded above
Every selected receiver edge appears once; native drape samples match field, no cubic overshoot
No invented all-ocean rivers or all-land water, disabled-layer output absent, cancellation honored
Same-view off/on rendered water; separate paths-only pixels; native ocean-reference suppression/restoration
All navigation frames retain visible indicators during native LOD; no new recipe input or inspection copies; one native owner
Background derivation and old/new native publication pairing
Existing Watershed topology, physical resolution/refusal, reference runoff, persistence, geology/volume composition, native zero set, authoring/Undo and background lifecycle checks
validation.build: Succeeded; existing deprecated CompressImageArray calls in unchanged legacy screenshot helpers still warn
initialCorrections: Native mesh validity exposed wet patches meeting only at saddle vertices; fixed with native fan splitting and numerical level tolerance.
Image review exposed world-unit line widths; fixed with native bScreenSpace pixel widths and an independent rendered-path assertion.

limits: This is potential fill-to-spill water and static drainage, not present water stage, flowing-water simulation or gameplay water.
Finite graph resolution limits shoreline topology and path selection; refinement cannot recover unsampled islands or channels.
Flat analytic terrain reveals angular finite-grid routes and ponding along conditioned corridors; debug visibility is not a new realism qualification of the existing hydrology.
Diagnostic lines use front-hemisphere foreground presentation, not physical occlusion.
Post-mining/dam drainage invalidation, closed-basin current levels, global metre-scale drainage, cooked water and multiplayer remain unqualified.
